note: write_heartbeat publishes through a per-writer mkstemp temp + os.replace; interleaved renewer/sidecar writes both succeed, no FileNotFoundError, no temp residue.
A .claim-<pid>-<ms> is adopted only when its reader pid is dead or the claim is older than CLAIM_ADOPT_GRACE_S; a live reader's claim is never re-consumed.
Pre-dispatch peek passes supervisor_proved_no_model=_trusted_local_command_uses_no_model(mission) instead of a constant False.
ENGINE_IDENTITY_UNOBSERVED now close_account(exit_class=PROVIDER_FAILURE) like MISSION_RECEIPT_WRITE_FAILED: OPEN + TERMINAL rows.
_started_counts_since: an unparseable started_at counts toward the cap; only a parseable instant before the freeze is excluded.
consume re-validates a charged reservation with available(resuming_attempt_key=...) which excludes the attempt's own spend; no second spend row.
available_standing applies REVOKE_SCHEMA rows (refusal REVOKED) before selecting a standing authorization.
metrics publishes tokens_total_completeness / tokens_per_accepted_milestone_completeness (COMPLETE | PARTIAL_FLOOR | UNKNOWN) next to the sums.
_resume_allowed arbitrates the budget before every --resume (T0/T2/T3); T0 records the first launch before the resume and the resume separately.

merged_view keeps each snapshot window's own source/observed_at (refresh_from_cli) and falls back to the global metadata only for screenshot windows.
latest_cli_signals keeps the latest signal per provider/scope in windows{}; merged_view merges every window before the any-window decision.
_standing_cap_for_project folds the ledger by attempt_key (resource_accounting.fold) before counting.
MissionState.step adds the retry's duration to the duration already burnt instead of replacing it.
Any failure after Popen (heartbeat OSError included) terminates + reaps the worker group before clear_worker_state; same on the autopilot EXECUTOR_ERROR path.
_run remembers the group created by setsid (pgid == child pid) and killpg's it after communicate instead of getpgid on a reaped pid.
The legacy PPID-1 argv net skips every pid known to the engine registry (protected_pids); registered engines are judged by the registry decision alone.

write_pid_file persists a birth-identity sidecar; cmd_stop verifies it (or a factoryd argv for legacy pidfiles) before any SIGTERM — FACTORYD_STALE_PIDFILE otherwise. Refinement 1078f3bda: a legacy pidfile is trusted only when the PROGRAM is factoryd (argv[0..1]), never on a mention in the command line.

_signal_target signals the pid when the group is unknown/absent but the pid is alive; kill_orphans journals ORPHAN_ENGINE_KILLED only once the pid is gone. Refinement 1078f3bda: EPERM on a zombie-only group is absorbed and the pid signalled; disappearance = dead or zombie.
observe_collection starts its own session, SIGKILLs the whole group on timeout and bounds the final drain (close pipes, wait).
_child_alive (pid alive AND same birth) is the single predicate used by reconcile (both checks) and the envelope scan.
_terminate_group TERMs the group, waits on the GROUP (killpg 0) for the grace, then SIGKILLs the group; KeyboardInterrupt cleans up too.
Settlement uses ctx._lease only when its mission_id is the settling mission's; otherwise the durable generation/token of that mission.
inject_heartbeat_interrupt resolves the lease through WorkerLease._lease_path (normalised name).

renew/tick_heartbeat take generation + fencing_token (_owner_matches); anonymous calls only on leases never bound to a pid; HeartbeatRenewer/WorkerHeartbeat pass their identity. Refinement a1fda3641: an anonymous tick/renew stays allowed to the owner PROCESS itself (lease.pid == os.getpid()).
adopt returns None (no FENCE, no ADOPT) when the lease carries a birth identity but the live one is unobservable.
tick_heartbeat refuses lease.is_expired exactly like current_generation.
_safe_mission_id appends a sha256 suffix of the full id whenever normalisation/truncation alters it; _read_nolock verifies the stored mission_id; legacy names still read when the id matches.
